scripts.signoff:generated: pnpm -r --filter './apps/agent/**' --filter './apps/studio/**' --filter './apps/controlplane/**' run generate && gh signoff generated
scripts.contracts: API_BASE_REF=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) pnpm -r --no-bail run ci:contracts pr
scripts.contracts:snapshots: API_BASE_REF=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) pnpm -r --no-bail run ci:contracts snapshots
scripts.dev:staging: set -a; [ ! -f .env.staging.local ] || . ./.env.staging.local; set +a; pnpm --filter @conservationtv/studio-api db:up && pnpm --parallel --filter @conservationtv/studio-api --filter @conservationtv/web --filter @conservationtv/agent-runner run dev:staging
